_comment: OpenI Indiana University chest X-ray (IU X-Ray). Only the required keys and expected_stats are written here. The other config fields are not written yet.

expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py. Source (2026-11-04): the 3,955 files ecgen-radiology/*.xml read with xml.etree and pandas, and Demner-Fushman et al., JAMIA 2016 (3,955 reports, 7,470 images). One row is one parentImage of an XML report (D-03): 7,470 images. 104 reports have no parentImage, so they give no row, and 3,851 reports stay. studies counts pmcId and patients counts uId: each report has its own uId, so 3,851 for both. rows_with_report counts the images whose report (FINDINGS and IMPRESSION joined) is not empty: 7,430. positives: the <MeSH><major> terms, matched as whole words (a final s can follow) with the triggers of the harmonizer, and a device term with the word breast does not count. uncertain: 172 images have only the term No Indexing, so every label is NaN. No sex, no age, no boxes and no masks in the source.
